resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Stony Point Tower Site is in Union County (US 499, PA 328) and is listed as no longer standing. It is a different site from the Carbon County tower in Hickory Run State Park, so it is not used as this tower's history.

notes_for_editor: Record claims not supported by any page we could read: built 1921, Aermotor design, height 14.3 m, and 'access unknown' (which we have replaced with a closed-access note from the Flickr caption). The Flickr caption is undated, so its 'not climbable' and fence statements may be out of date. The Wikidata entry gives coordinates and park, but no date or design. Wikimedia Commons has a photo file, Stony Point Fire Tower.jpg, linked from Wikidata; its licence was not checked, so it is not added to photos. Hickory Run State Park's Wikipedia gallery also captions a Stony Point Fire Tower photo but gives no date. A human should check the DCNR or Forest Lookouts records for a build date before this story is published as more than low confidence.
